subject: Post-demo: CardioLabs compliance triggers + deployment options
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@cardiolabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: CardioLabs compliance triggers + deployment options

Alex — thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick written recap so we have aligned next steps and to capture the compliance asks that will drive which deployment mode makes sense.

Call summary (high level)
- CardioLabs will process PHI and must be covered by a signed BAA.
- Security requires SOC 2 Type II evidence and access to audit logs for vendor assessments.
- Procurement asked if a Dedicated or Private VPC/on‑prem option is required vs using Hosted API under a BAA.

Why this matters for deployment mode
- Hosted API + BAA: fastest to production for non-PHI workloads and some deidentified flows; limited customer-managed network controls.
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool, VPC peering): predictable throughput, isolation for PHI if paired with BAA and approved routing.
- Private on-prem / air-gapped: available but adds procurement and implementation time and costs — typically used where regulatory or data residency mandates it.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm whether CardioLabs intends to send raw PHI to Redwood, or whether you will deidentify before calling the API? (procurement says this affects timeline)
2) Procurement/security requested our SOC 2 Type II report, BAA template, and sample audit log exports. I attached the meeting notes.
3) If you lean to Dedicated/VPC or on‑prem, please provide the procurement contact and an expected procurement window (weeks).

I'll coordinate an internal technical deep-dive (Rishi/runtime team) to scope Dedicated/VPC network requirements if you want to explore that path in parallel. Proposed timeline: technical deep-dive next week, and a procurement-ready packet by end of next week if you confirm PHI scope.

Attachments: redwood_meeting_notes_20280515.txt

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Morgan <alex@cardiolabs.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@cardiolabs.com, security@cardiolabs.com
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: CardioLabs compliance triggers + deployment options

Diego — helpful summary, thanks. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We will be sending PHI for the MVP (patient notes and identifiers). De‑identification is not possible for the current use case.
- Procurement timeline: they are targeting contract sign-off in ~8–10 weeks, but want vendor evidence up front (SOC 2, BAA, encryption/KMS details).
- Security will need sample audit logs (at least token-level request logs, timestamps, and user identifiers) and confirmation of customer-managed KMS support for encryption at rest.

Attached is the InfoSec vendor questionnaire (cardiolabs_infosec_questionnaire.xlsx) — please flag any items that need product or legal to answer. I will introduce our procurement lead (cc'd) once we have the pricing options for Hosted+BAA vs Dedicated/VPC vs on‑prem.

Alex Morgan
Head of Platform Engineering | CardioLabs
alex@cardiolabs.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo: CardioLabs compliance triggers + deployment options

Looping in a suggested approach from GTM and Security so we can move quickly and cover procurement asks. High-level recommendation: two-track proposal.

Two-track approach (recommended)
1) Short path — Hosted API with signed BAA + SOC 2 evidence for non-PII/deidentified flows (fast, lower cost).
2) Production path — Dedicated capacity (VPC peering or customer VPC) as the canonical option for PHI workloads; provide estimate for Private on‑prem only if procurement deems required.

Action items (owners)
- Diego: confirm PHI scope with Alex (done) and gather procurement contact.
- Evelyn: pull latest SOC 2 Type II report, BAA template, and example audit-log export; confirm KMS options (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed).
- Marissa: prepare pricing matrix + two-track SOW draft and timeline (I’ll own the procurement packet).

Timeline proposal
- Security packet (SOC 2, BAA, logs) to Alex by EOD Friday (May 19).
- Tech deep-dive with runtime (Rishi + infra) week of May 22 to scope Dedicated/VPC.
- Pricing + SOW to procurement within 1 week after tech deep-dive.

I attached a draft SOW shell to iterate from (draft_two-track-sow.docx). Keep responses bulletized so procurement can paste into their RFP doc.

Thanks — keep this tight, procurement will move fast once they have evidence.

Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions & GTM | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@cardiolabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: CardioLabs compliance triggers + deployment options

Alex — thanks for the prompt replies and for sharing the questionnaire. We’ll follow Marissa’s two-track plan. Quick confirmation / asks from our side so we can deliver the procurement packet by Friday: 

1) Procurement contact name & email to loop them into pricing/SOW (procurement@cardiolabs.com is fine, but a named contact speeds the process).
2) Any specific SOC 2 sections your team prioritizes (e.g., availability, confidentiality, change management)? If not, we’ll deliver the full report plus a short controls summary.
3) Are there minimum SLA/latency targets the product team will require for the PHI flows? This helps sizing for Dedicated.

Proposed next step: technical deep-dive with Rishi (runtime) on Tue May 23 at 10:00am PT — confirm if that works and I’ll send a calendar invite. 

Attachments included: redwood_baa_template.pdf, redwood_meeting_notes_20280515.txt

Best,
Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Diego Fernandez | diego@redwoodinference.com
